_comment: Row 750: an IPv6 address that CARRIES the cloud-metadata endpoint (::ffff:169.254.169.254, 2002:a9fe:a9fe::, 2001:0:...:5601:5601, 64:ff9b::a9fe:a9fe) must be judged on the IPv4 it carries, before the private/loopback relaxation. Each mutant removes one unwrap or puts the relaxation first; each must be CAUGHT. Every anchor is zero-width on purpose (row 357): the mutation is the inserted line, so the matched span carries no value-bearing token. The companion row750_ipv6_unwrapped_metadata_transform_control.json must ESCAPE. Re-run from a detached scratch copy with the venv symlinked in: toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row750_ipv6_unwrapped_metadata.json M9 is the NEGATIVE CONTROL's own positive control: The NEGATIVE CONTROL's own positive control. Every other mutant here proves the unwrap is load-bearing; this one proves the cut cannot buy those catches with a blanket refusal. It leaves every metadata spelling refused (the two counting tests stay green) and takes away only the LAN/loopback relaxation the plex/jellyfin/home-assistant/stash hooks exist for, so ONLY test_the_hook_relaxation_survives_the_unwrap fails -- which is what 'the negative control fails for the intended reason' means.
subject: the embedded-IPv4 unwrap in hooks.py and provider_resolve_impl/_common.py, and its position before the private relaxation

mutants.label: M1 hook unwrap yields nothing (the pre-750 outer-only classification)
M2 hook unwrap drops the 6to4 view
mutants.new: carried = [c for c in carried if c != addr.sixtofour]

mutants.label: M3 hook unwrap drops the Teredo view
mutants.new: carried = [c for c in carried if not addr.teredo or c not in addr.teredo]

mutants.label: M4 hook relaxation runs first: private answers skip the never-allowed set
mutants.new: addrs = [answer for answer in addrs if not answer.is_private]

mutants.label: M5 provider classifies the wrapper again (the pre-750 shape)
M6 provider unwrap drops the NAT64 view
mutants.new: carried = [c for c in carried if addr not in _ip.ip_network(_NAT64_WELL_KNOWN)]

mutants.label: M7 provider unwrap drops the IPv4-mapped view
mutants.new: carried = [c for c in carried if c != addr.ipv4_mapped]

mutants.label: M8 provider never-allowed set is read off the wrapper instead of the carried view
M9 the correction over-refuses: the private relaxation is withdrawn with the unwrap
mutants.new:
if a.is_private or a.is_loopback:
            return False, f"refusing private address ({host} -> {a})"
